title: Adaptive Limits of Algorithmic Cryptocurrency Trading from a Complex Adaptive Systems Perspective: An Empirical Study on Human-AI Collaborative Strategy
summary: Negative crypto-bot means remain negative after EMA switching. Positive relative bear alpha is not profitable insurance; no human policy was tested and no qualified new futures strategy established.
about: Iterative RSI/MACD/Bollinger/Fear-and-Greed crypto bot, V3 regime score, Q-learning/sentiment variants and a proposed human-AI framework.
findings: Author main n=80: V3 -2.76% mean period return vs B&H +14.87%. Separate n=35 EMA adaptive -0.64% vs always-on -2.27%, paired p .036. Both adaptive absolute/relative means are negative; not independently reproduced.
mechanism: Proposed crowding/regime adaptation is unobserved. Reduced long exposure/cash can explain relative bear outperformance. No proven positive-return or hedge mechanism.
build_on: Retain causal-state, cash/exposure baseline, dependence/selection and cost lessons. No new indicator or discretionary regime switch, queue entry or acquisition task warranted.
code_feasibility: Prototype EMA/V1 calculator possible, faithful V3/human policy not specified: Trend Score weights/modes, indicator/clock/sentiment vintages, cash/hold and order rules missing. Only source/statistical audit code built.
